author: Joshua Fluke
description:
I found a job posting paying $160,000–$180,000 a year that starts out like a normal chemical manufacturing position… and then turns into something completely different.

The role involves chemical production, manufacturing, research and development, equipment maintenance, quality control, bookkeeping, graphic design, website work, sales and eventually becoming a future COO and owner.

That would already be a lot.

But then the job posting starts talking about religion.

Applicants are expected to help establish and develop a religious organization called the Pilgrim Saints of Jehovah, participate in developing its doctrine, live according to its moral and ethical code, work six days a week, observe a Sabbath day of worship and have, acquire or establish a large family.

The position also offers housing and transportation.

So naturally I had some questions.

title: THIS JOB PAYS $180K… BUT THERE’S A CATCH
